title: Canned Beans
subtitle: In the pocket, there are green peas, flat beans, bitter beans ... It's not hard to tell them apart.

trails.title: A Notice of Use
trails.description: Related to one of the most advanced armaments in a bygone era.

content.text: Villiers W5 Strategic Razor (Enhanced Version) Instructions for Use

I. Preparation
The Villiers W5 Strategic Razor (Enhanced Version) is issued to the Foundation Special Operations Teams (FSOT) and will be distributed along with other equipment during your initial gear issuance. Please carefully check the equipment receipt list to confirm that you have received the correct model and number of items.
The Villiers W5 Strategic Razor (Enhanced Version) is developed by the Laplace Scientific Computing Center (LSCC). Designed for the daily mission needs of human team members, it does not require Arcane skills to operate. Before official use, proficiency in the correct use of this equipment is required, and the user must pass related practical training assessments.

II. Awakening and Linking
When first equipping the Villiers W5 Strategic Razor (Enhanced Version), please manually awaken and link the weapon by performing the following operations:
▪Sit with eyes closed and perform deep breathing in 10-second intervals until the body reaches a meditative state;
▪After opening your eyes, silently count to 5 seconds, then grasp the handle of the equipment with both hands. Release your hands after feeling a slight vibration, at which point the Villiers W5 Strategic Razor (Enhanced Version) will be awakened and successfully linked to you.

III. Parameter Setting
When first equipping the Villiers W5 Strategic Razor (Enhanced Version), please follow these steps and wait for the weapon to adjust its parameters according to your body data:
▪Grasp the handle of the equipment with both hands, quickly clench, and relax, repeating 3 times;
▪Place the equipment upright, with the tail end against the tip of your right foot, raise your chin, and wait for the razor to buzz once;
▪Place the equipment horizontally, lift the razor to shoulder height, turn your head left and right once each, and wait for the razor to buzz once;
▪Read clearly in a moderate voice: "Entities should not be multiplied unnecessarily." Wait for the razor to buzz once.

IV. Equipment Maintenance
The maintenance cycle for the Villiers W5 Strategic Razor (Enhanced Version) is 3 months.
If you believe the weapon is exhibiting abnormalities, please contact the customer service personnel at the LSCC. Follow the instructions of the customer service personnel to send the weapon to the Computing Center, so that the center's technicians can check and debug your weapon's performance.

items.text: Canned Beans
Dungeon, Island

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes, all is well.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Those dolphins sent us to the other side of the currents.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: And one more thing, captain, and I'm asking this with no ill intention. Errrr, may I know your lineage?
The blue flower gently conveys the answer back to her.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Thank you. I wish your next mission would be trouble-free, too.
Sonetto sighs softly in relief and turns the knob back to the original position.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The members of the Razor Squad are all humans.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's clear then.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: "Real numbers" refer to arcanists, and "imaginary numbers" mean humans.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Then what is the rest of this nonsense?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Sonetto, Vertin, and this APPLe are "integers."

items.speaker: Ms. Radio
items.text: While Ms. Lilya and I are "fractions."

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Don't bother asking, I am pureblood.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This APPLe is also made of pure apple juice.

items.speaker: Ms. Radio
items.text: I only consume 1.5V DC.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So it's not determined by our lineage, or Regulus would have been an integer, too.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So why on earth am I the irrational number?! Why only me?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Unfair! I demand the ruling be changed!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Shut up. We grappled hard to get you on this island.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: So you have no choice but to stay in the worst guest room.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You call this a guest room? A cell, more like!
The cell is left unlocked—so clearly some vestige of human rights and dignity remains on the island.
Regulus shakes the railing as fiercely as if England had just lost the World Cup.

items.speaker: Ms. Radio
items.text: Perhaps this piece of news will cheer you up.

items.speaker: Ms. Radio
items.text: "We are prisoners in the world, and our body is the cage of the soul ..."

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Cut me a break. Might as well play us some rock music.
Her chief mate appears calmer than the captain still wrestling with her fate as much as the railing.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Hmm, seems the residents on this island venerate integer numbers.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: And irrational numbers, or non-terminating, non-repeating decimals, cannot be represented as the ratio of two integers; hence, they are discriminated.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No, no, no. Who are they to judge and decide me to be the irrational number?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I, I was the only person who didn't cause any damage to the Foundation in the previous protest!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Woo-ah! Why do I get to have the worst of both worlds ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I've requested information from Ms. Moissan about Apeiron. But it will take some time for the files to come in.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The captain of the Razor special operation squad told me this might be a settlement of a group of arcanists who have been long cut off from the world.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Unlike other unregistered arcanists, these people chose not to live alongside the humans. They still lead an ancient arcanist way of life and follow the old customs. We must be meticulous when getting in touch with them.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But they use modern mathematical terms, and that girl talked about Kaprekar—he was an Indian mathematician active in the first half of the 20th century.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I think they are not living in complete isolation. They are still in contact with the outside world.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This place wouldn't be affected by the "Storm," just like the Olitiau base, Foundation headquarters, and my suitcase.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The travel notes in 1999, Manus Vindictae showing up in Olitiau's base, the "Storm," or Emanation ... They must be somehow connected.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And we'll find our answer here, I think.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Very energetic, captain.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: By the way, how come nobody is here to welcome us?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: They wouldn't suddenly decide to detain us all just because we have an irrational number here, right?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I'm with you all the time.
A reluctant figure walks out of the shadow in the corner.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: 6 asked me to welcome you.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ah, scared me again. What were you doing hiding in the corner?!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Because it seemed you were in the middle of proving a conjecture.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: According to the scripture, disturbing others when they are giving proofs of their arguments is as sinful as eating beans.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I don't want to be bound to the rocks of the Caucasus Mountain and have vultures eating my eyes after my death.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Eating beans?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Eating beans is the sin of sins.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: The biggest, worst, and ugliest crime. People eating beans will never transmigrate. They deserve nothing but eternal punishment.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa, are you serious? Is this rule only for soybeans? What about broad beans? Snow peas? Chickpeas?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: And what does it say about other bean-based products?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Beans are beans.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Haha, you're funny. This doesn't even make sense! By this logic, aren't the coffee drinkers going to rot in hell?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I happen to have a box of coffee beans in my bag.
The Rockin' Pirate produces her treasure and waves a single bean around her mouth, looking for a reaction.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: If I put one coffee bean in my mouth, will the vulture get me right away?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: No way!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa, easy, mate! Do you wanna get physical? This Pirate is not scared of you!
The coffee beans are knocked over. Some restless, small figures start to rustle in the shadows.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: That's not fair! The critters are coming to your aid!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is not good. We need to separate them.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Let go! Let gooo! What are you, a dog?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Vertin! Sonetto! Lilya! Get her off me!!
Huh?!
What is going on here?
37, let go of the guest's head, now!
37 sticks out her tongue and lets go of Regulus reluctantly.
She returns to the corner, giving the floor to the rest of them.
Sorry that I'm late.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I'm Sophia, the Corrector of Apeiron. I will take over from here.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Oh, finally, we have an ordinary person here.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Please, let's talk on the way to the outside.
TO BE CONTINUED…
